title.zh: Casey 的 Witness Wednesday：谈插值

subtitle.en: Casey Muratori's Witness Wednesday series leaves grass planting behind and moves on to interpolation in general.
subtitle.zh: Casey Muratori 的 Witness Wednesday（每周三连载）离开种草这个具体话题，转向更通用的插值问题。

blocks.en: He's put up another very informative blog post, leaving the specific topic of grass planting, venturing into more general territory regarding interpolation. And there's a video, from which it is possible to learn a lot of this is a new subject.
blocks.zh: 他又贴出了一篇信息量很大的博客文章，这次离开了种草这个具体话题，进入了插值这块更通用的领域。另外还有一段视频，从中能学到不少东西，这个题目对他来说也是新的。
